Title: Hope and Service
Description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Florina has requested you aid Feldan save what you can at Olcott Farm and then meet her at the Church in Everfall.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_worry" />It's painful to admit, but when the Olcott farm fell to the Lost, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I offered to help them reclaim their valuables.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsRequest" />Please, convince old man Olcott to leave. If I don't get him back to town safely... <g id="female_sobbing" />well, I couldn't bear it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_sighRelief" />So you made it out of the farm with your soul intact? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />And I suppose you reclaimed the Olcotts' keepsakes as well?

Title: The Covenant Enclave
Description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Florina has asked you to visit her brother Lethold at the Covenant enclave in south-eastern Everfall. She has attuned your spirit with the shrine, so you may travel there safely.
PlayerPrompt: "I can do that. What's the message?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_touchhands" />Thank you. Lethold undoubtedly worries for my welfare, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />so please reassure him.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />I really do suggest you inquire about becoming a Covenant Initiate yourself. On Aeternum, it's critical one finds a higher purpose to serve.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsLeanPlead" />Please, good visitor, tell me, have you come from Oxboro?

Title: Justice and Courage
Description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Lethold beseeches you to rush to Clearview Crypt to end whatever terrible acts are transpiring, save Templar Damiano, and return to him at the Covenant Enclave.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodSympathySmall" />Their cowardice has very likely led them to a dark fate, <g id="male_headShakeNo" />though it is neither surprising nor unjust.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I must consult with Lumen Morellus about this alleged heresy. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I hope you find Damiano, and the Initiates as well. <g id="male_lookDown" />I pray they are still whole.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_explain" />The fortitude of Templar Damiano is proven by his safe return,<g id="female_salute2finger" /> though it is your courage that saved him.

Title: The Lumen's Words
Description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Adjudicator Lethold has asked you to speak with Lumen Morellus at the Covenant Enclave for your final initiation test.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodunderstand" />Very well. I must attend to cleansing the foul presence of those Initiates from our sacred halls. <g id="female_crossarms" />	When Florina returns, <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I hope all this is far behind us.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_convince02" />I suggest you speak with the Lumen soon. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />There is no reason to delay.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Thank you for giving me this chance to express my gratitude for the rescue of Templar Damiano.

Title: Inspiration and Redemption
Description: Covenant Initiation Quest: Morellus has enlisted you to lure the Corrupted Templar back to Nettlerest Graveyard, best him in battle, collect his cursed necklace, and return to the Convenant Enclave.
PlayerPrompt: "I can be trusted in such things."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />I expected as much. <g id="female_explainS" />The problem I need help with is related to Templar Titus Invectus, the one who oversaw the training of our fallen Initiates.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_leanpointConvince" />I strongly suggest you do not attempt to use the relic. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It is an insidious poison, Corruption.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />There, now we can safely say this whole sordid affair is concluded with some measure of redemption.

Title: Committing to the Cause
Description: Covenant Recruitment: You can now join the Covenant.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_clenchfistsGetpumped" />I am thrilled to hear you affirm your interest. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />The Covenant will shine brighter with you standing in our ranks.
InProgressResponse: Take<g id="female_youknow" /> your time, this is not a decision to be made lightly.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: N/A

Title: A First Step of Many
Description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Lieutenant Tibbs wants you to collect Lost Ears and a Knight's Signet ring at Lugdunum Fields for some sort of magic and then meet him at the ruin steps to the North of the farm.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />That's the spirit! <g id="male_explain" />Northwest's a fort filled with unbelievable wonders. Need odd things to get inside. Magic, you see.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Oi! Won’t get far loitering around here with these louts! <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Look, you get them ears, and I promise, I’ll show you something special, sure as my name's Tibbs.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Don’t give me that look, this place is FULL of wonders! <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Look at me, looking at you, eh!

Title: Fortune Favors
Description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Lieutenant Tibbs has directed you to thrash some pirates and steal some black powder barrels at the Pirate Stockpile and then return to the Marauders Enclave.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Oi, no, no! Though it is Lost again. <g id="male_noway" />Pirates round here, always a pain in our side.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Those powder barrels, aye? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />We’ll be using those to impress Strou'dahia in the next step of our little plan.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_goodnews" />Oh ho! Someone's got a mess of booty! <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Hope you gave those blackguards a good walloping. How’s the prize? <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Ten percent for me then, eh? Fee, tax, and all.

Title: Threshold Guardian
Description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Lieutenant Tibbs has asked you to speak with Gladiator Strou'dahia at the Marauder Enclave for your final initiation test.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_chuckle" />Oh ho! There it is! Those bombs ain't the only things with spark! <g id="female_explainS" />Now, go talk to Gladiator Strou'dahia, and show the Marauders what you've got!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_pointsoutthere" /> Off you trot, mate. <g id="female_crossarms" />Talk to the Doctore and I'll await your return.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />Good, stand before me. You have fought boldly so far. <g id="female_explainS" />	Should you wish to join our ranks I have one final test of strength and skill. It is time. Let us begin.

Title: Broken Bones and Blasted Bulwarks
Description: Marauder Initiation Quest: Gladiator Stroudahia has ordered you to best Varangians and rescue captives at Stonereach Keep. You must also complete Tibb's secret mission, before returning to the Marauders' Enclave
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_crossarmsJudge" />The Varangians have begun to take some of our members prisoner. <g id="female_smackfist" />No Marauder lets their brethren stay in chains.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Were it you in captivity, you would hope for a quicker rescue? Suffering festers through inaction.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Those who would risk themselves to save their comrades are always welcome in the Marauders.

Title: One of Us
Description: Marauders Recruitment Quest: You can now join the Marauders.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodYes" />This is good to hear. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I would be honored to fight beside you in the battles ahead. <g id="male_explain" />	I've already spoken with Smiggs. Go to him and he will enter you into our charters.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Go to Smiggs with haste. <g id="male_goodnews" />Tonight, we feast!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: n/a

Title: Fickle Fusions, Fanged Folly
Description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has hired you to lure the altered wolves to Midnight Den and destroy them, then meet him at the Syndicate Enclave to the north-east when you are finished.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nod2" />Yes, and the most valuable kind, indeed, if you assist!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsDisapprove" />Do not feel too sorry for the wolves. <g id="male_explain" />Given the nature of the island, they are a menace in their best state.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />After that mishap with the wolves, <g id="male_patience" />I must return to experimenting and trying anew. A different formula, or perhaps a new approach.

Title: Over the Cliffs, and Through the Woods
Description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has tasked you to climb the cliffs nearby into Brightwood and east into the grove of the Azoth Tree to collect water from the moat, and then return to him.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodProud" />You're sharp! No progress comes without danger.<g id="female_giveitem" priority="high" /> Take this bottle, mind the cliffs, follow the path into Brightwood. Go through the grove, and then to the moat.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_explainS" />Climb over the cliffs to the northeast. We have left markers as guides for the initiates.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handsHipsConsider" />Now you've seen the Azoth Tree. It was truly beautiful, no? Well worth a little danger.

Title: Woes of the Wise
Description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Aventus has asked you to speak with Cabalist Cleo Elsayad at the Syndicate Enclave for your final initiation test.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodProud" />Oh, I believe you are. Go to her, and keep an open mind. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />The task she has prepared may challenge you in more ways than one.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_nodProud" />Go, and speak to Cleo. I eagerly await your return to the enclave.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Ah, a moment if you please. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Thank you for speaking with me, Aventus has had much to say about you.

Title: Burden of Responsibility
Description: Syndicate Initiation Quest: Cleo has requested that you travel to Broken Hull Hold, pour the sleeping draught into their wells, disrupt their reserves, and return to her at the Syndicate Enclave.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodYes" />Indeed. <g id="male_explain" />This is an Azoth-infused sleeping draught, with which I hope to subdue our immortal foes.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />It is a grim proposition, to be sure.<g id="male_spreadhands" /> But what should be done?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />You return victorious. <g id="female_salute2finger" />You are truly committed to the application of knowledge, and not just its pursuit.

Title: True Knowledge
Description: Syndicate Recruitment Quest: You can now join the Syndicate.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Now that is some joyous news. Your letters of recommendation have already been furnished. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Go to Scrivener Astrid and she will process your records into our charters.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Please, go to Astrid. She already has your letters of recommendation in her files.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: N/A

Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Gladiator and then complete the Trial of the Gladiator quest from the Enclave.

Title: Marauder: Trial of the Gladiator
Description: Defeat the Lost and their leader, Pirate Lawrence of the Long Shadow to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Gladiator. Talk to Commander Silas at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
PlayerPrompt: "Can't be too hard. You made it."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_proud" />Oh, a really smart tongue on this one. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It's a shame I don't have time to make you eat those words.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Smart. You should make sure you're ready before facing Lawrence.<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" /> Could take some time. Possibly forever.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Saw you speaking with Tibbs over there. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Not sure that was what I had assigned, but I bet you were getting help.

Title: Marauder Advancement: Ravager
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Ravager and then complete the Trial of the Ravager Quest from the Faction Representative in Weaver's Fen.

Title: Marauder: Trial of the Ravager
Description: Defeat a clan of bears in Greyvale Grotto to advance to the rank of Ravager. Talk to Commander Silas at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
PlayerPrompt: "Just tell me what I have to do."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Ha ha! Still cocky. But the bears of Greyvale Grotto will teach you a bit about humility.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_order" />Make your way to Greyvale Grotto in Brightwood. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />And try not to die. It reflects poorly on all of us when Gladiators get eaten by wild beasts.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />Back so soon? I assume you've come to concede. I suppose you can still serve under Tibbs' command, if he isn't too ashamed of you.

Title: Marauder Advancement: Destroyer
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Destroyer and then complete the Trial of the Destroyer quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.

Title: Marauder: Trial of the Destroyer
Description: Defeat the corrupted ex-marauders in the Great Cleave. Talk to Lieutenant Tibbs at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nod1" />Unfortunately, yes. <g id="male_rememberBig" />We fought together, honorably, at one time, but due to events in the Great Cleave, he turned.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Careful out there. Great Cleave is treacherous… for all of us. <g id="female_order" />Report to Strou'dahia once you've recovered the amulet.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_casualhail" />Welcome back. So you recovered Florent's amulet? <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />If it was the amulet that caused the old boy to fall, any clues to where it came from?

Title: Marauder Advancement: Commander
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Commander and then complete the Trial of the Commander quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.

Title: Marauder: Trial of the Commander
Description: Defeat Corrupted Commander Silas and return the corrupted amulet to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Commander. Talk to Lieutenant Tibbs at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Silas gave into fury and pride, and embraced Corruption. It's a stain on the honor of all Marauders. I'm sorry to say that Silas still wears an amulet awarded to her.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Our task is grim, but the Marauders must take the difficult path, even when dealing with those we do not like.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_nodConsider" />It is done then? Ah yes, this amulet is a symbol of your accomplishment. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have served as an exemplar of the tenets we adhere to.

Title: Marauder Advancement: Champion
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Champion and then complete the Trial of the Champion Quest from the Faction Representative at the Enclave.

Title: Marauder: Trial of the Champion
Description: Brave the dangers of Brimstone Sands and Hornhold to prove you're worthy to advance to the rank of Champion. Talk to Gladiator Strou'dahia at the Marauder Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />As a Commander of the Marauders, you have the chance to become one of the very best of the Marauders.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Many have failed at this trial, so I do not have to tell you twice to think with a keen mind and a cautious eye. The rest... Well, that is up to you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />I see you have spoken with Tibbs. The look on his face was all that I needed.

Title: Syndicate Advancement: Scrivener
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Scrivener and then complete the Trial of the Scrivener Quest from the Enclave.

Title: Syndicate: Trial of the Scrivener
Description: Defeat Lost Gheist Malikor and use the Psychokinetic Absorber to capture any ectoplasm to earn the rank of Scrivener. Talk to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />You have arrived at the perfect moment, <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />for I am ready to test my new Psychokinetic Absorber.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Have you located Malikor yet? He's somewhere out there. <g id="male_beckonUrgent" />Use the Absorber and bring back the traces of his soul!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_smile" />Ah, at last! Yes, yes, you see? There are traces of Malikor's soul in here! This could change everything!

Title: Syndicate Advancement: Chronicler
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Chronicler and then complete the Trial of the Chronicler quest from Alchemist Krockes at the Enclave.

Title: Syndicate: Trial of the Chronicler
Description: Gather ectoplasm and soul traces from the various Lost in Periville and return to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave to earn the rank of Chronicler.
PlayerPrompt: "Will you give me the trial again?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />After our first success? <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Of course! I consider you a most audacious companion!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Gather the specimens for our work in the Fen, and then I will see you advanced in rank.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Really? You got all of it? And rather quickly too, I think. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Your abilities once again prove you are an invaluable resource!

Title: Syndicate Advancement: Cabalist
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Cabalist and then complete the Trial of the Cabalist quest from Alchemist Krockes at the Enclave.

Title: Syndicate: Trial of the Cabalist
Description: Place Psychokinetic Absorbers at strategic points in Mourningdale to earn the rank of Cabalist. Talk to Alchemist Krockes at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is done.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Oh right, yes of course, <g id="male_rememberBig" />I am doing perfectly well. I just was distracted.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Those Psychokinetic Absorbers won't place themselves. <g id="female_smackfist" />The sooner, the better. The research never ends, my friend!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Perfect! Perfect! <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have accomplished quite the feat, and this harvest will be invaluable to me-- <g id="female_bowHead" />and the Syndicate of course.

Title: Syndicate Advancement: Alchemist
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Alchemist and then complete the Trial of the Alchemist quest from Cleo Elsayad at the Enclave.

Title: Syndicate: Trial of the Alchemist
Description: Defeat Alchemist Krockes and absorb his soul into the Psychokinetic Absorber and then return it to Cleo Elsayad to earn the rank of Alchemist. Talk to Cleo Elsayad at the  Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_patience" />The way it always does with the undisciplined. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Too enamored of their research and their reputation.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_youknow" />When you find Krockes, don't hesitate. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />I suspect he has become quite… volatile.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Then the deed is done? Krockes is no more? Well done!

Title: Syndicate Advancement: Magus
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Magus and then complete the Trial of the Magus quest from Cleo Elsayad at the Enclave.

Title: Syndicate: Trial of the Magus
Description: Venture to Tempestas Custodia to obtain the work of Syndicate Researcher Sigurdsson and return it to Cleo Elsayad to earn the rank of Magus. Talk to Cleo Elsayad at the Syndicate Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />Ah yes, <g id="male_explain" />well you see there had been Syndicate researchers dispatched to study these sites. <g id="male_spreadarms001" />One of particular interest was called Tempestas Custodia.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Sigurdsson was a fine researcher, but I do wonder if he was in over his head in the Elysian Wilds.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_liftHandsXs" />Well done, I knew that you could be trusted with such a monumental task. You will be named a Magus immediately.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Templar
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Templar and then complete the Trial of the Templar quest from Beatris Roose at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Templar
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Templar and then complete the Trial of the Templar quest from Beatris Roose at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Templar

Title: Covenant: Trial of the Templar
Description: Track down the Apostate Covenant Initiate Bremen Luca and attempt to discover what happened to him to advance to the rank of Templar. Talk to Templar Roose at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
PlayerPrompt: "I am ready. What do I do?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />An Initiate, like yourself, has asked some uncomfortable questions. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />A few that, I'm afraid, we cannot allow.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsConvince" />Find the Apostate and offer him his final rest. May he at last find peace, at least for some time.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_beckon" />Ah, you have returned! I have taken over the Trial. Adjudicator Roose is otherwise occupied.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Excubitor
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Excubitor and then complete the Trial of the Excubitor quest from Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant: Trial of the Excubitor
Description: Find the second page of the journal of Bremen Luca to advance to the rank of Excubitor. Talk to Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_worry" />Something of grave concern. My son was named an Apostate, yet he was not the only one excommunicated from the Covenant.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_order" />Travel the Fen and find what my son was investigating. <g id="male_patience" />Then I will grant you the rank of Excubitor. Remember, we must not tell the others.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />You found this page? And… prayer beads? These are beads of the Covenant. That must mean these were once Covenant members.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Lumen
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Lumen and then complete the Trial of the Lumen quest from Livia Luca at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant: Trial of the Lumen
Description: Find Bremen Luca's journal at Hollowing Fort and recover Prayer Beads from Corrupted Templars to earn the rank of Lumen. Talk to Adjudicator Luca at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_thinking" />I have continued piecing together the fragments of my son's journals. He mentioned someone called Templar Ambrose who went to Great Cleave.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_clasphandsGratitude" />Your help has been invaluable to me, and to the entire Covenant.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />This was when he made a discovery about some of the leaders, then. <g id="male_rememberBig" />He uncovered the fallen of the Covenant, and they punished him for seeking the truth.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Adjudicator
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Adjudicator and then complete the Trial of the Adjudicator quest from the Lethold at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant: Trial of the Adjudicator
Description: Lay Corrupted Adjudicator Luca to rest and find Adjudicator Roose to earn the rank of Adjudicator. Talk to Lethold at the Covenant Enclave when the task is complete.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_sighAcceptnews" />Our scouts report that she has turned to the Corruption. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />If that is the case, she must be dealt with, and it may mean that Adjudicator Roose is in peril as well.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_handheart" />I shudder to think Luca might have fallen, but we must do what is necessary for the Covenant. <g id="female_smackfist" />May justice be swift for those who turn to Corruption.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_handheart" />It's done, then? Perhaps she will find peace in death. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />And I see that Adjudicator Roose has returned. You have done what has been asked of you and more.

Title: Covenant Advancement: Paladin
Description: Earn enough Faction Reputation to qualify for the rank of Paladin and then complete the Trial of the Paladin quest from the Lethold at the Covenant Enclave.

Title: Covenant: Trial of the Paladin
